verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out of them. Log streaming, private cloud isolation and data residency are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
